Tokens

128 tokens in the --ll-* namespace. They flow one way only: Figma variables → extraction pipeline → one generated stylesheet. No agent and no developer ever writes a token by hand; this page is generated from the same artefacts the library ships (tokens.json + tokens.css).

Spacing

The spacing ladder, built on the base unit --ll-s (the ladder arithmetic multiplies it: s-275 = 2.75 × 8). Each bar is drawn at the token's actual size via its own custom property.

Type

Tokens derived from the Figma type/* text styles by the extraction pipeline. Each style is a set of custom properties named --ll-type-<style>-<prop> (family, size, weight, style, line-height, tracking, case); the family aliases the Typography font tokens above. The specimens are rendered by these variables.

Theme axes

There is no light/dark axis — the palette is a single dark theme by design — and no density axis since 2026-08-30. The one theming axis is element-scoped: the host application sets the attribute on the root element or any subtree element, and the subtree inherits it. The bare root defaults to data-accent="ambre".

Accent — data-accent

Swaps which accent primitive --ll-accent resolves to. Try the switcher in the header — every live preview on this page follows it.

ambre bleu rouge violet jade current (--ll-accent)

Role — data-role

Maps a product role onto an accent; a role attribute wins over an inherited accent in the cascade.

RoleAccentPreview
support ambre
adc bleu
top rouge
mid violet
jungle jade
